Class ConfirmedCauseLabelStore

java.lang.Object
com.shaft.doctor.label.ConfirmedCauseLabelStore
public final class ConfirmedCauseLabelStore extends Object
Gitignored local workspace store for user-confirmed Doctor cause labels (issue #5971 / S3-05).

Keys are Doctor historical-signature strings. Values are CauseCategory values overlapping ReportPortal / BrowserStack defect buckets. Evidence paths are never persisted.
